messages:
maya: We keep losing billing tags crossing Hosted->Dedicated/Private. Proposing a small immutable handshake envelope.

alex: +1. trace_id ok but tenant and model_pin often missing downstream.

jordana: Minimal required fields: req_id, tenant_id (hashed allowed), hosting_mode, model_pin, qos_hint, est_tokens.

sam: Also include origin_auth and optionally sig_b64. Signed only when key available.

infra-bot: Reminder: use both headers and body manifest. Some sidecars strip headers.

alex: Enforce strict verification in Hosted/Dedicated, permissive in Private behind RW_STRICT_HANDSHAKE.

jordana: Error semantics: 428 missing, 422 invalid, 503 overloaded. Add X-RW-Handshake-Drops header when fields dropped.

maya: Streaming must carry stream_id and seq0. Adapters persist mapping for reassembly.

sam: CI: add adapter-lint that checks for header usage and fallback JSON envelope.

maya: Action owners: alex proto draft Tue, jordana lint Wed, sam metrics Thu, maya security Fri. infra-bot created RW-1244.
